claims.text: The 60-second apnea window ending at 2000-01-03T04:48:00+00:00 (window index 287) from recording a03 was classified as normal by the detector.

The detector's reconstruction error was 1.3989, well below the anomaly threshold of 190.8744, yielding a normalized margin of -0.9927; these are reconstruction threshold evidence, not probabilities or calibrated confidence.
The model is a BiLSTM temporal-attention autoencoder (fusion_apnea_loso_a03, version apnea-03-a03_seed2026) trained on the apnea dataset and tested on patient a03.
No signal-level or attention-level evidence was available for this window; attention would represent shared window-level temporal relevance, not causal or channel-specific importance.
The current evidence indicates a normal classification for this window, supported by the detector's reconstruction margin and model provenance, with no signal or attention evidence available.
